note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written in our own words from the cited sources; where a source lists a method as unconfirmed, the guide says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn. It pops automatically once the other 54 are done, so treat the rest of this guide as its checklist: story first, then the 100% completion list, then the side questlines and the cleanup trophies. There is no separate task, no multiplayer and no DLC requirement.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and see it through to the end. It is the first mission of the game and the trophy unlocks automatically when it ends, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter closes, which PowerPyx places at the start of the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens with the mission Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Per PowerPyx, the trophy pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The trophy pops after its final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the game. PowerPyx notes it closes with the same mission that ends Chapter 4, Starting From Zero, so it pops with the story's conclusion and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. It is a main mission, so the trophy unlocks automatically as you play through the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story. PowerPyx stresses it is far from true 100%: roughly 60% of everything in the game, for example any 200 of the 277 base vehicles scanned, any 100 of the 255 animals studied through binoculars, any 70 of the 80 challenges, and any 100 optional missions. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable, so finish the story first and clean this up in free-roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and notes the under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Track them by region in Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Check Progress, Activities to see which types you have done; per PowerPyx the nine are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Most come up naturally in the story and while clearing other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges (PowerPyx). Work through each range's challenges and repeat until you hit the gold score; the challenges are short, so treat it as a grind you chip away at between story chapters.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 races in total across them (PowerPyx). You need a win at each location, not a win in every race.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so pick the 20 easiest for you; wins at distinct locations are what count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked purple on the map — follow his fishing questline to the challenge and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are four video games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck (PowerPyx). The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of any one of them once is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3; a call from Andy leads to her address in Belville. Complete her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last. All quests remain available after the story (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It is marked in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked KR in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing here is missable (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only certain strangers count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among them — while other questlines such as Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Strangers stay available in free-roam after the story; check the trophy tracker for your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered; scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against his list, steal them, and drive them to his garage in west Vice City in good condition for a better payout. Track it under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, available only as Jason. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty; purple markers point to synthetic labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then complete Spin On This to shut them down and the trophy pops (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice). THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you can accept and follow her. That meditation adds to your counter but is not marked as a spot, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — do it anyway, and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1. You cannot do the final spot until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations; the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is marked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break; as Jason you get a text that starts Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Follow his hunting requests and bring the animals back to him; he gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle on the first quest. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, and that his 15 Target Decks also feed the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists 18 card sets in the game; work through any three sets in full. Cards are a collectible type, so use the in-game collectible tracking and PowerPyx's card-set guide to find the sets you are closest to finishing.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations — hold up on the D-pad and R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures (PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags). There are more than 100 in the world, so any 100 count; scan as you travel and it finishes naturally.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Only 50 are needed here and 70 for the 100% checklist, so pick the easiest ones and skip the hardest. Track them under Progress, Challenges; most fill in naturally while you work on other trophies (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. You need both characters together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner with right on the D-pad plus Triangle. Build 4 stars, then break out of the red heat zone on a fast bike; PowerPyx recommends the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vaults trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the flashing red and blue wanted level (not the red heat level) the whole time, looting three robbery targets in a row. Bring your partner, wear a vest, and carry sticky bombs and healing items. PowerPyx suggests the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — rob a couple of items in each, break the safe in the back with sticky bombs, and note the pop comes about half a minute after leaving the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan them with the WAiNK app (hold up, then R1) — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base vehicles, so this pops on the way (PowerPyx). Check counts under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and line up five enemies — PowerPyx suggests criminals at gang operations, and notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA and fly away. It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. PowerPyx points to the plane at terminals E3 and E4: get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off, and fly at least 1 km from the airport before it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and use it until the trophy pops. PowerPyx places the tanks in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; drive in through the gate and take one, then shoot enemies with it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently opening alarmed doors and marks jewelry robberies on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, and destroy the security footage and disable the alarm before leaving. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City; the pop comes shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which introduces vault robberies — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a bag. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip (after his Payday Loans quests). There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way; each vault pays up to $205,000 (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission, That's Where The Money Is, counts as one automatically — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts. Earlier, you can also block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, and escape the red heat radius; sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. PowerPyx recommends a plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so one per gang pops this early. They are marked with yellow icons when you get near them; track each gang under Progress, Gangs (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx pins it down: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Per PowerPyx, steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City — you need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS first — then drive it straight through the showroom window. It only pops from that blue Banshee, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III, and the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, steal all three key valuables — the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation). You visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; the trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can return for the rest, so it is not missable (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength (heart icon). You need both characters, so start after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Buy a gym membership and always train together — call your partner with right on the D-pad plus Triangle — because the partner trains automatically alongside you. Filter for fitness clubs on Map, Activities (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. The trophy list itself shows your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) to see each action register. PowerPyx lists the profile tiers — Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and the permanent Irredeemable — and notes it fills passively through robberies and fights; if it is your last trophy, it can be farmed quickly, though high-violence profiles make police shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 19 November 2026, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No confirmed method exists yet — check back in the guide's sources rather than chasing rumours; the description's hint is 'Second time's the charm.'

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This is the UFO easter egg. Per PowerPyx: go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car, approach the UFO's blue light, and it drops an abducted woman; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists this as currently unknown as of 19 November 2026, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by. Treat that as unconfirmed: try knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving bike, and check the sources for a confirmed method as players crack it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and hand the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across robberies, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one job, so it comes naturally while clearing robberies for the 100% checklist (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they are the most expensive. PowerPyx counts 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — spend anywhere and the total adds up.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are also 4 story garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale after Chapter 2's Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Fund it with robberies, which pay far more in Chapters 3 and 4 (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after Chapter 2's Moses mission; it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you. You need enough garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register; early on he only takes vehicles without trackers, and from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down (PowerPyx).
